The first thing I did was ask the WebSurfer to find the director. They came back and said the director is Michael Thornhill. That seems right because I remember IMDb and Wikipedia both mention him as the director.

Next, I needed to find out where Michael Thornhill was born. I asked the WebSurfer again, this time specifically for his birthplace. They showed me some results from DuckDuckGo, which said he was born in London, England. But then I saw that IMDb said he was born in Sydney, Australia. That's conflicting. I need to figure out which one is correct.

I thought maybe the WebSurfer made a mistake by not checking enough sources. So I asked them again, this time using more specific searches, like checking the NFSA website. The NFSA didn't have his birthplace either. I also tried looking at his obituary and other biographies, but they didn't help. It seems like there's no definitive answer, but I'm leaning towards Sydney because IMDb is usually reliable. Maybe the London info was a mix-up.

So, the mistake here is that the WebSurfer didn't cross-check enough sources to confirm the birthplace accurately. They provided conflicting information without resolving it properly. That's why I'm still unsure about the exact birthplace.
